summary: Iteration 59 — RouteMail Phase 2 Batch A end-to-end PASSED. Coverage: (1) TestTemplateRender 13 cases — render_template('Hi {{first_name}}', {}) == 'Hi there' (generic), {'first_name':'Anna'} == 'Hi Anna' (resolved), '{{Dhruv}}' → 'Hi ' (stripped), '{{First Name}}' with first_name data → 'Hi Anna' (case+space tolerant), single-brace {first_name} legacy resolved, 'Section A' → 'Section A' (HTML entity decoded), '{{}}' and '{}' empty braces stripped, fallbacks={'company':'your team'} honored, per-campaign fallback beats generic, extract_template_variables normalises (first_name/company/legacy_var), analyse_contacts produces correct missing_per_variable + warnings + ok=false, empty recipient list yields 'No recipients to validate' warning, regression real-world render produces no `{`/`}`/`{}`/` ` literals. (2) TestCampaignFolderLink 3 cases — POST /api/campaigns with folder_id persists and returns folder_id in response + GET /campaigns; POST without folder_id triggers _ensure_default_folder_id which auto-creates/links 'Default' folder; PUT /api/campaigns/{id} updates folder_id correctly. (6) TestFoldersEndpoint 1 case — GET /api/leads/folders returns folders[] with per-folder reply_count + workspace-level unassigned_reply_count. action_items: Phase 2 Batch A ships clean. No functional defects. template_render, folder linking, preflight endpoints, register_sent_email extension, reply auto-routing, and folder reply-count endpoint are all working as specified.

Minor UX suggestion (not blocking): when the user has zero brand folders, the Brand/Folder select shows 'No folders yet — a Default folder will be created' as a non-selectable option. This is correct, but main agent could optionally pre-create the Default folder on first /leads/folders GET so users see at least one option in the dropdown. Currently, the backend handles this gracefully via _ensure_default_folder_id on save.
critical_code_review_comments: template_render.py is a clean 234-line module with well-scoped regexes. _DOUBLE_BRACE_RE and _SINGLE_BRACE_RE both allow letters/digits/underscores/dots/dashes/spaces — matches spec for {{First Name}} normalisation.
_normalise_key collapses dots/dashes/whitespace to underscore — so contact field 'First Name' matches data key 'first_name' and template '{{First.Name}}' all resolve identically. Good.

Resolution order is correct: data lookup → campaign fallback → generic _GENERIC_FALLBACKS → empty string. The 'never leak {x}' guarantee holds because _STRAY_DOUBLE_BRACE_RE strips any un-rendered {{tokens}} at the end.
clean_html_artifacts handles   BEFORE html.unescape() to avoid double-decoding edge cases. Good defensive ordering.
_ensure_default_folder_id (server.py L4577) is idempotent — find-or-create on 'Default' name per user_id. Safe to call multiple times.
Preflight endpoints correctly limit contact scan to 2000 docs (campaign uses email_list_contacts, drip uses drip_contacts). For larger lists, a representative sample. Good enough for warnings.
register_sent_email signature is now keyword-only after `*` — prevents positional-arg breakage. Solid pattern.

Reply matching at unibox_routes.py L260-292 falls back from message_id/in_reply_to → references → recipient+account+subject regex. folder_id inheritance is unconditional on `matched` — correctly None if no sent_email matched (becomes unassigned_reply).

/leads/folders endpoint (unibox_routes.py L528) loops folders sequentially to count replies — fine for typical folder counts (<100). For workspaces with many brand folders, could be optimised with $group aggregation, but not a blocker.
Campaign.jsx (~2000 LOC) — Send Now path: saves campaign, calls /preflight, then opens preflight-dialog if warnings exist (L413, L1929-1990). preflight-confirm-send routes to /start. Clean flow.
Old CreateCampaignRequest payloads without folder_id still work — Optional + _ensure_default_folder_id ensures backward compatibility as flagged by main agent.

Endpoints to test: POST /api/campaigns (folder_id, variable_fallbacks), POST /api/drip-campaigns (same), POST /api/campaigns/{id}/preflight, POST /api/drip-campaigns/{id}/preflight, GET /api/leads/folders. Important: template_render.py uses {{...}} for double-brace AND {...} for legacy single-brace; only double-brace gets the generic fallback ('first_name'→'there'). Single-brace tokens that don't resolve in data are silently stripped (no fallback) — by design (avoids breaking JSON-like content in bodies).
